dimensions.assessment: Affects public land management in Clark County, Nevada, and regional water infrastructure development by the Southern Nevada Water Authority.
dimensions.evidence: expands the boundaries of the Sloan Canyon National Conservation Area in Clark County, Nevada, and grants rights-of-way... to the Southern Nevada Water Authority

dimensions.assessment: Adjusts conservation area acreage from 48,438 to 57,728 acres and authorizes major utility infrastructure and material disposal rights.
dimensions.evidence: striking '48,438' and inserting '57,728'... constructing and operating water transmission and related facilities

dimensions.assessment: Grants rights-of-way without payment of rents or other charges, though specific dollar figures are not provided.
dimensions.evidence: grant to the Southern Nevada Water Authority... not subject to the payment of rents or other charges

dimensions.assessment: Amends federal public land law to adjust conservation boundaries, mandate rights-of-way, and require an MOU for material disposal.
dimensions.evidence: amends the Sloan Canyon National Conservation Area Act to adjust the boundary... and grants rights-of-way

dimensions.assessment: Permanent boundary expansion of the federal conservation area and permanent infrastructure rights-of-way.
dimensions.evidence: temporary and permanent water pipeline infrastructure... powerline, facility, and access road rights-of-way

missing_information: Estimated construction costs and economic valuation of the water pipeline project.
importance_detail.rationale: Expands the boundaries of the Sloan Canyon National Conservation Area in Nevada by about 9,290 acres and mandates rights-of-way for a water transmission pipeline.
